description: Every trade on Kraken's public market for a crypto pair (BTC/USD, ETH/EUR, SOL/USD) from any moment back to the market's opening, tick by tick: time to the microsecond, price, size, which side took liquidity and the order type, with the VWAP, buying against selling, the largest trades and one-minute bars built from the ticks. Up to 10,000 trades a call; next_since reads on exactly where it stopped. No key.

pair.description: A crypto pair on Kraken (BTC/USD, ETH/EUR, SOL/USD) or a coin's name (bitcoin reads BTC/USD).

requests.description: Requests of up to 1,000 trades each. Default 2.

since.description: Instead of start: next_since from an earlier answer, to read on exactly where it stopped (or to poll for newer trades).

start.description: The moment to read from: an ISO time (2024-01-01T14:30:00Z) or a date (its UTC midnight). A time without a zone is UTC.

ticks.description: Return the trades themselves (the first 1,000; the summary and bars cover all read). Default true.

name: trade_ticks

outputSchema.description: ticks and bars are tables (columns and rows), oldest first; summary covers every trade read; next_since continues exactly where this read stopped.

title: Crypto trades, tick by tick
